notes.text: R3-10 is fixed. The R4-9 guard is correct in the Broker, but the Harness turns its 400 into an unknown outcome, so one malformed string from a client permanently blocks the Session and its Workspace. On d472033c the same request only had its content changed. Still present on 67c908ea.
